description: This file defines the EmploymentContractService class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing employment contract attachments related to employees, including retrieving, saving, and deleting contract attachments via interaction with underlying DAOs and services.

classes.name: EmploymentContractService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to handle employment contract attachments for employees, including retrieval, saving, and deletion.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO responsible for employment contract data interactions, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Returns the service responsible for employee attachment operations, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the contract attachment for a specified employee number, returning the first attachment if available.

methods.name: getContractAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific contract attachment by attachment ID for a given employee.

methods.name: saveContractAttachment
methods.description: Saves a given EmployeeAttachment as a contract attachment, setting the appropriate screen context.

methods.name: deleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Deletes the specified EmployeeAttachment from the storage.
